camel_example: aliyun dds DescribeAvailabilityZones --region cn-hangzhou --MongoType dbfs --StorageType local_ssd --EngineVersion '5.0' --ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-b' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmx2m4rqu7pry' --ReplicationFactor 3 --DBInstanceClass 'dds.mongo.standard' --InstanceChargeType PrePaid --DbType normal --StorageSupport local --AcceptLanguage zh --ExcludeZoneId 'cn-shanghai-g' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --InstanceType replicate --ExcludeSecondaryZoneId 'cn-shanghai-b'

description_zh: 查询MongoDB实例支持的可用区列表
kebab_example: aliyun dds describe-availability-zones --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-b --instance-charge-type PrePaid --db-type normal --resource-group-id rg-acfmx2m4rqu7pry --accept-language zh --storage-support local --mongo-type dbfs --storage-type local_ssd --exclude-zone-id cn-shanghai-g --exclude-secondary-zone-id cn-shanghai-b --db-instance-class dds.mongo.standard --engine-version 5.0 --replication-factor 3 --instance-type replicate --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAvailabilityZones

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query the latest available regions
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query available zones
parameters.help_zh: 可用区ID，您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html查询
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the product. Valid values:

- **PrePaid**: subscription

- **PostPaid:** pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型。取值：
- **PrePaid**（默认值）：包年包月。
- **PostPaid**：按量付费
parameters.name: instance_charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The architecture of the instance. Valid values:

- **normal**: replica set instance

- **sharding**: sharded cluster instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例的数据库类型。取值：
- **normal**：副本集实例。
- **sharding**：分片集群实例
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the returned **RegionName** and **ZoneName** parameter values. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese

- **en**: English
parameters.help_zh:
指定返回参数**RegionName**和**ZoneName**的语言，取值说明：
- **zh**：默认值，中文。
- **en**：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

parameters.help_en:
The storage type. Valid values:

- **cloud**: displays only zones available for instances that use cloud disks.

- **local**: only displays zones available for instances that use local disks instances.

- **default** or unspecified: displays zones available for instances that use cloud disks and those that use local disks
parameters.help_zh:
存储类型：

- **cloud**：仅展示支持云盘版实例的可用区。
- **local**：仅展示支持本地盘版实例的可用区。
- **default**或空：展示本地盘和云盘版实例都支持的可用区
parameters.name: storage_support

parameters.help_en: The edition of the instance. High-Available Edition and Preview Edition (dbfs) are supported
parameters.name: mongo_type

parameters.help_en:
The storage type. Valid values:

- **cloud\_essd1**: PL1 Enterprise SSDs (ESSDs)

- **cloud\_essd2**: PL2 ESSDs

- **cloud\_essd3**: PL3 ESSDs

- **local\_ssd**: local SSDs

> * Instances that run MongoDB 4.4 or later only use cloud disks to store data. If you do not specify this parameter, the value **cloud\_essd1** is used by default.
>
> * Instances that run MongoDB 4.2 and earlier only use local disks to store data. If you do not specify this parameter, the value **local\_ssd** is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
存储类型，取值说明： 

- **cloud_essd1**：ESSD PL1云盘。
- **cloud_essd2**：ESSD PL2云盘。
- **cloud_essd3**：ESSD PL3云盘。
-  **local_ssd**：SSD本地盘。

>- 4.4及以上版本实例只支持云盘，不填写默认选择**cloud_essd1**。
>- 4.2及以下版本实例只支持本地盘，不填写默认选择**local_ssd**
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en: The zone ID that is excluded from the query results
parameters.help_zh: 当前地域过滤此输入的可用区查询结果
parameters.name: exclude_zone_id

parameters.help_en: The secondary zone ID that is excluded from the query results. You can configure the ExcludeZoneId and ExcludeSecondaryZoneId parameters to specify the IDs of multiple zones that are excluded from the query results
parameters.help_zh: 当前地域过滤此输入的可用区查询结果，结合“ExcludeZoneId”实现多可用区过滤
parameters.name: exclude_secondary_zone_id

parameters.name: db_instance_class

parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en:
The number of nodes in the instance.

> This parameter is available only for replica set instances.

Valid values:

parameters.help_zh:
节点数。

> 该参数仅支持副本集实例
parameters.name: replication_factor

parameters.help_en:
The architecture of the instance. Valid values:

- **sharding**: sharded cluster instance

- **replicate**: replica set or standalone instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例类型，取值： 
- **sharding**：分片集群实例。
- **replicate**：副本集实例和单节点实例
